mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments ( id, order_id, status, amount, provider_reference, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{id}, orders.id, 'PENDING', orders.total_amount, #{providerReference}, NULL, #{now}, #{now} FROM orders WHERE orders.id = #{orderId} AND orders.user_id = #{userId} AND orders.status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, status, amount, provider_reference, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM payments WHERE id = #{id}
